verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS fintech product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an in-product assistant that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server lets external agents call the Stripe API, 'Issuing for agents' issues cards for third-party agents to spend with, and the ML risk scores are a fraud feature. All three are adjacent features, not an embedded assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
